description.value:
Frequency at will

Requirement Marked quarry at or below half its maximum Hit Points

Your Strike deals an extra 4d8 precision damage instead of your normal precision bonus, and this damage ignores that creature's resistance to precision damage.

cinderfall.incomplete: Blocked on the Mark, and independently: pf2e has no native "bloodied"/half-HP tracked roll option to predicate against (that's a different game's condition, not pf2e's). The Waywarden's central subsystem, The Mark (classes.waywarden.json flags.cinderfall.terms[0]: "designate a creature as your quarry, gaining a growing bonus to track, target, and punish it specifically"), has zero Foundry-schema footprint anywhere in the corpus. classes.waywarden.json:65 itself carries "rules": []. No card anywhere grants a TokenMark effect (site/data/cards/abilities/, class-features/, feat-effects/ are all empty scaffold directories -- confirmed via ls, contents are .gitkeep only). Real pf2e's own equivalent mechanic (Ranger's Hunt Prey) is fully buildable and precedented, but that infrastructure (an action item + a TokenMark-carrying effect item) does not exist for Waywarden and is not one of the 56 files in scope for this draft. This card is blocked until a future pass authors the base Mark action/effect.
